raw_comment:
I noticed that the droughts were generally the worst in both the Northern and Southern central however there are still parts of central part of America that aren't experiencing any droughts as well as differing 2-4 differing severities of droughts within the same states leading to drastically different affects depending on where you are. What I wonder is how often do these droughts occur, how long do they last and is this a product of Global warming, if so how much has the increase in world temp affected these droughts over the years. I don't find this drought to affect me that much as where I live the drought is moderate and I personally haven't noticed it's effects in real time.
A catchy title for this graph is Americas going to be cooked
